notes.title: Update No. 5.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A separate single game has been added, the cooperative mode has become more difficult.
[*] Improved game interface
[*] Improved balance on all game levels
[*] Bugs fixed
[/list]

notes.content:

[/list]

notes.title: Update # 3.0 Hall of Fame / Level Choice
notes.content:
The new update adds the names of the Steam users who left their [url=https://youtu.be/5KtjteSxvWM]feedback on the game page.[/url] 

Added a choice of levels, now you can immediately play at any level by calling the red arrow with the text 1,2,3 ...

Changes to levels, fixed bugs, improved game balance.

notes.title: Update # 2.0 Game Balance
notes.content: The levels were updated, the [b]game balance was improved[/b], additional quests were added, the levels became more and more interesting. The time of passing the game has increased.

tags.balance_change: The time of passing the game has increased.
